sources.count_notes: Verified: Arizona securities regulator is the ACC Securities Division, not DIFI. Oversight covers securities, securities dealers and salespersons, and investment advisers and their representatives (Securities Act of Arizona; Investment Management Act). Keep ACC Securities and DIFI separate.

sources.source_name: ACC Securities Broker & Adviser Search (BrokerCheck / IAPD)
sources.count_notes: Official public tools are FINRA BrokerCheck and SEC IAPD. Investigator on duty (602) 542-0662. Do not scrape BrokerCheck or IAPD.

sources.source_name: ACC Securities list request (CSV on public-records form)
sources.count_notes: Official form offers CSV for: AZ-registered dealer firms (name, CRD, address, contact name/phone); IA firms licensed in AZ (name, CRD, address); IA firms notice-filed in AZ (name, CRD, address). Individual S7/S6/IAR lists are people — suppress. A.R.S. § 39-121.03. Commercial purpose requires notary. Request not filed this ticket. Counts UNKNOWN, not zero. This is the only remaining-hub path to a real Arizona state-registration business list.

sources.identity_field: CRD when printed; ACC docket/order number always
sources.count_notes: Year-grouped HTML tables with PDF orders and eDocket links. Many 2026 rows print CRD. Some rows are name-only — those are UNSAFE for adverse attach. Attach only on CRD, ACC file/docket, or order number. Not a roster.

Existing Investor census AZ principal-office n=213 (inv-home-001-census.json, READ-ONLY). AZ principal office != Arizona state IA registration. Notice-filed vs state-licensed vs principal-office are three different grains. Do not treat 213 as the Arizona-licensed RIA roster.
